mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m') AS yearMonth, COUNT(*) AS newMemberCount FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT WHERE CREATED_AT >= #{start} AND CREATED_AT < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY yearMonth ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalParticipationCount, COUNT( CASE WHEN ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END ) AS completedParticipationCount FROM CHALLENGE c INNER JOIN CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce ON ce.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE WHERE c.END_DATE >= #{start} AND c.END_DATE < #{end} AND c.END_DATE < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND c.DELETE_YN = FALSE AND ce.STATUS != 'CANCELED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL

SELECT c.CODE AS challengeCode, c.TITLE AS title, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.MEM_CODE) AS participantCount FROM CHALLENGE c INNER JOIN CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce ON ce.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE WHERE ce.JOINED_AT >= #{start} AND ce.JOINED_AT < #{end} AND c.DELETE_YN = FALSE AND ce.STATUS != 'CANCELED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL GROUP BY c.CODE, c.TITLE ORDER BY participantCount DESC, c.CODE ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '서울%' THEN '서울' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '부산%' THEN '부산' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '대구%' THEN '대구' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '인천%' THEN '인천' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '광주%' THEN '광주' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '대전%' THEN '대전' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '울산%' THEN '울산' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '세종%' THEN '세종' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경기%' THEN '경기' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '강원%' THEN '강원'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '충북%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '충청북%' THEN '충북'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '충남%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '충청남%' THEN '충남'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '전북%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '전라북%' THEN '전북'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '전남%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '전라남%' THEN '전남'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경북%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경상북%' THEN '경북'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경남%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경상남%' THEN '경남'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '제주%' THEN '제주'
ELSE '미상' END AS regionName,
COUNT(*) AS participationCount
FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce INNER JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE LEFT JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.CODE = ce.MEM_CODE
WHERE ce.JOINED_AT >= #{start} AND ce.JOINED_AT < #{end} AND c.DELETE_YN = FALSE AND ce.STATUS != 'CANCELED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL
GROUP BY regionName ORDER BY participationCount DESC, regionName ASC

SELECT sales.sellerId, sales.completedTradeCount, sales.totalSalesAmount, m.CODE AS memberCode, m.RATING AS memberRating, ( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = m.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'profile' AND i.DELETE_YN = FALSE ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profileImage
FROM ( SELECT SELLER_ID AS sellerId, COUNT(*) AS completedTradeCount, SUM(PRICE) AS totalSalesAmount FROM MARKET_DEAL_LOG WHERE CREATED_AT >= #{start} AND CREATED_AT < #{end} GROUP BY SELLER_ID ) sales LEFT JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.ID = sales.sellerId ORDER BY sales.totalSalesAmount DESC, sales.sellerId ASC
